text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Yasuda Kinen, and Sakura Chiyono O nervously prepares for the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It doesn't matter if she's passed her physical peak or not. She swears to prove she's still growing either way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Waiting for her on the track is Bamboo Memory, who switched from running dirt races to turf races with immediate success.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O steels herself to run against this up-and-coming Umamusume as the Yasuda Kinen begins.
